feeds.title: Bashgah Blog
feeds.description: The first choice of Iran Stock Exchange investors. Bashgah's blog cover topics such as stock exchange training, investment, stock buying, useful stock exchange concepts, brokerage, participation bonds, housing facilities, news and announcements and capital market training.

feeds.title: Sharif Investment and Finance Management Group
feeds.description: Sharif Finance and Investment Management Group, as the first specialized training center in the field of financing and investment, started its activities extensively in 2004 with a focus on promotional and educational activities in this field. The main approach of the group is financial innovations and providing practical and operational training services to various sectors.

feeds.title: Academy Wave Blog
feeds.description: The Wave Academy team, led by Mr. Amin Dehghan (Amino), is trying to teach the basics of topics related to capital markets and Forex training. Unlike all educational systems that prescribe a series of classified training for all people, this academy explains and implements the prerequisites and the type of personal training and personal programs for each person by analyzing each person separately.

feeds.title: Arka Invest Blog
feeds.description: Arka Invest is an asset management company under the supervision of the Stock Exchange and Securities Organization. Our goal is to use the knowledge and expertise of capable and committed forces to help individuals and legal entities, institutions and organizations to move confidently and calmly towards their financial goals.

feeds.title: Dolphin West Blog

At Dolphin, we enable you to communicate with our experts about your transactions or other issues and to solve your transactional problems.

feeds.title: Agah Invest Blog

feeds.title: Bamboo Blog
